part.label: Rounded Corner Bracket With Arc Profile
part.description: A mounting bracket whose footprint has one rounded (filleted) corner authored directly in the profile via a point's `curve`, instead of a separate fillet feature -- useful when the rounded corner is part of the footprint's own intended shape rather than a post-hoc edge treatment. The rounded corner is a quarter-circle of radius 5mm, replacing the sharp top-right corner: the arc's `through` point is deliberately the arc's own 45-degree midpoint (not merely 'a bit past the corner'), since threePointArc's three points must all lie on one well-formed arc -- an ill-chosen through point can produce a wildly different (and likely unintended) arc through all three points instead of the small local bulge intended. See docs/composable-parts.md, "Component kinds", for that caveat.

components.description: Rectangular footprint with a quarter-circle rounded corner (radius 5mm) at the top-right, replacing what would otherwise be a sharp corner.

features.description: Mounting hole away from the rounded corner.
